answer: Resist sybils with a sedimentary capability ledger: each identity must stack verified work as successive shale strata over many epochs, and every stratum is sealed only when a rotating meadow of unrelated peers co-signs a quartz hash of that layer. Rewards drip solely through continuous stacks; a missing stratum collapses the claim to bedrock. Clone farms can mint accounts instantly but cannot wait out geological depth across sealed layers, so mass identities starve without real multi-epoch labor.
